rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for stirring liquid or soft food with a utensil.

example.english: I stir my coffee evenly with a spoon.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ci4 gang1 gaau2 wan4 bui1 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this when something or someone begins to move slightly from being still.

example.english: The cat finally began to stir.
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 zung1 jyu1 juk1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a person is emotionally touched or moved by something.

example.english: Your help really does stir me.
example.traditional: 你咁樣幫我，真係令我好感動。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 bong1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for coming round or waking from sleep or unconsciousness.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 fan3 seng2 faan1 laa3
